methods.M0_population_metrics: mean member accuracy + oracle only; no decomposition, no integrity checks
methods.M1_decomposition_baseline: correct oracle/best-fixed/dev-fixed decomposition + glob-dup/NaN integrity checks
methods.M1b_M1_plus_policy: M1 + fixed comparator policy (dev selection, bare fallback) + 1-call cost matching
methods.M2_full_diagnostic: S1-S5 with frozen A-E states, thresholds, abstention rules
methods.M3_ablations: M2 minus repeat check / minus info condition (documented as ablated S3/S4)

method_comparison.note: M0 on C4 would report high oracle and miss best-fixed=bare; M1 decomposes but has no abstention rule (reports headroom as actionable); M1b adds policy but no integrity gating; M2 gates every claim through S1-S5. On C8 both M0 and M1-style metrics look healthy (corrupt judge/missing cells) while only M2's S1 refutes.

notes: calibration iterations: ABSTAIN_EPS 0.05->0.15; dev-accuracy prior removed from policy; C6 mechanism redesigned to dev/eval drift; expectation corrections C3-D REFUTED, C6-B SUPPORTED (documented in control manifest notes). Blind instances were never used during development.
